d:
'sarafroshi ki tamanna ab hamare dil men hai'
Aam taur par ye mana jata hai ki ye gazal ram prasad bismil ne likha hai. lekin bahut kam hi logon ko pata hoga ki iske rachyita ramaprasad bismil nahin, balki shayar bismil azimabadi the.
Bismil azimabadi ke pote munavvar hasan batate hain ki ye gazal aazadi ki laraee ke vaqt kazi abdul gaffar ki patrika ‘sabah’ men 1922 men chhapi, to angrezi hukumat tilmila gaee thi, aur inke pichhe siaaeedi laga di thi.
